MATTER / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Hydromancy.

Symbolic or divinatory interpretation of water, its surface, reflections or movement.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Hydromancy
Hidromancia

A reading of water or phenomena observed in it, interpreted within a divinatory framework.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

Historical accounts describe more than one water-reading procedure. Reflections, ripples, vessel shape and light are physical observations that can be documented alongside a particular symbolic reading.

MatterHand scaleHuman scale

FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Describe the water, vessel or outdoor setting before observing.
  2. Record visible motion and lighting without moving the setup during the record.
  3. Add the interpretive framework after preserving the observation.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Include an overview showing the vessel or shoreline and a close view of the water.
  • State whether the water was still or moving and record the viewing direction and light.

POTPOURRI / PERSONAL INTERPRETATION

Share a photograph or a record.

A photograph, drawing or dated record can be sent privately for a personal reading. Include the procedure and the question.
